what: cold `cargo test --locked --no-run -j 6` wall time before and after folding the two templated integration-test families (tests/sd18_*_widening.rs, tests/sd13_*progression*.rs) into one binary each

machine.note: shared box; the SD-35 Epic 1 E1-001/002/005 lane was building and running the full suite in its own worktree during runs 1 and 2 — see the load fields

command: CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<fresh dir, rm -rf'd first> /usr/bin/time -v cargo test --locked --no-run -j 6
load_note: load_before / load_after are /proc/loadavg 1/5/15-minute averages at the start and end of the run; a paired run means before and after were measured back-to-back with the same (quiet) box state

runs.label: before
runs.tree: the cycle-start tree, 184 family files as 184 binaries
runs.comparable: quiet box at start; matches the launch audit's 2:44.51 at 4c4d07f89d (workflow-instruction.md §1 item 10)

runs.label: after
runs.comparable: NOT comparable to run 1: the other Epic 1 lane's full `cargo test` build (590 binaries, /tmp/cargo-sd35-AT-35-E1-005) ran concurrently — load 40 on 24 cores at the end. Kept because a measurement is reported, not discarded; runs 3 and 4 are the paired re-measurement

runs.label: before (paired)
runs.tree: `git archive 53296d80f0 | tar -x` export to /tmp/e1003-before-tree — the untouched cycle-start tree, 184 family files as 184 binaries
runs.comparable: paired with run 4: same box state, back-to-back, started when the 1-minute load was under 3.0 (waited 0 s); the load_after values on runs 3 and 4 are the -j 6 build itself

runs.label: after (paired)
runs.sha: 53296d80f05fe8c32e867f90dd5064a125187f32+working-tree (the consolidation, before its commit; tests/ identical to the committed tree)
runs.comparable: paired with run 3 (its load_before is run 3's own tail — the 1-minute average had not decayed in the 12 s between them)

paired_rerun.verdict: after < before on the paired quiet-box runs (3 vs 4), and also against the quiet-box run 1 (164.49 s → 145.89 s, −11.3%); run 2 is the only after > before and it was measured under another lane's full build (load 40)
paired_rerun.what_the_seconds_are: cargo's --no-run is dominated by the `codex` library compile (~2 min, unchanged) plus one link per test binary; 182 fewer links is the whole delta. The 70-minute full-suite figure the operator complained about (workflow-instruction.md §1 item 10) is test execution, not compile: this cycle's `cargo test --locked --no-fail-fast -j 6` after the fold ran 01:55:07Z → 02:32:45Z (37.6 min, 8656 passed / 0 failed / 67 ignored across 408 targets) — but under a contended box for its first 10 minutes and a quiet one after, so it is a single observation, not a paired measurement
paired_rerun.re_derive: bash <scratchpad>/e1003_paired.sh — or by hand: export the before SHA with git archive, then in each tree `rm -rf $CARGO_TARGET_DIR; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 /usr/bin/time -v cargo test --locked --no-run -j 6`, back-to-back

test_count.list_command: cargo test --locked -j 6 -- --list 2>&1 (stdout+stderr merged so each entry keeps its `Running tests/<file>.rs` target)
test_count.diff: artifacts/epic-1-tax-cut/test-list-diff.txt — verdict=IDENTICAL, 0 only-in-before, 0 only-in-after, after each `<module>::<name>` entry of the two folded binaries is mapped back to its original file `tests/sd18_<module>_widening.rs` / `tests/sd13_<module>_progression.rs`

test_binaries_built.derive: grep -c 'Executable tests/' on the --no-run stderr; 184 family files became 2 binaries
